section: NITI Aayog - structure, mandate, verticals, differences from the Planning Commission
subsections: NITI Aayog - full form, establishment, mode, status
Composition - full-time, part-time, ex-officio, special invitees

accepted.s: Which of the following sets correctly represents the four principal areas of the mandate of NITI Aayog?
o: Agricultural marketing; customs administration; currency printing; census operations
Knowledge and innovation; NITI for States; driving transformational change; monitoring and evaluation
Fiscal federalism; monetary policy; public debt management; industrial licensing
Defence production; foreign policy; judicial reforms; election management
accepted.x: The mandate of NITI Aayog covers knowledge and innovation, NITI for States, driving transformational change, and monitoring and evaluation.
accepted.tq: Match the institution’s mandate with its actual functional areas and reject unrelated governmental functions.
accepted.sec: NITI Aayog - full form, establishment, mode, status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes the Vice-Chairperson from the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog?
o: The CEO is the ex-officio Chairperson, whereas the Vice-Chairperson is nominated by the Finance Commission.
The Vice-Chairperson and the CEO are separate posts; both are appointed by the Prime Minister, but the CEO has a fixed tenure and the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
The Vice-Chairperson is a constitutional authority, whereas the CEO is a statutory authority.
The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the President, whereas the CEO is appointed by Parliament.
accepted.x: The Vice-Chairperson and CEO are distinct offices. The Prime Minister appoints both; the CEO has a fixed tenure and the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
accepted.tq: Separate two closely associated offices by comparing their appointing authority and service status.

accepted.s: Who was the first Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog?
accepted.x: Sindhushree Khullar was the first CEO of NITI Aayog. Amitabh Kant and B.V.R. Subrahmanyam served later as CEOs.
accepted.tq: Identify the inaugural office-holder rather than the better-known subsequent incumbent.

accepted.s: Ashok Kumar Lahiri became Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog after replacing:
accepted.x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri was appointed Vice-Chairperson on 25 April 2026, succeeding Suman K. Bery, who had held the post from May 2022.
accepted.tq: Use the immediate predecessor trap in questions involving successive office-holders.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog:
1. The CEO is appointed by the Prime Minister.
2. The CEO holds the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
3. The tenure of the CEO is fixed.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The CEO is appointed by the Prime Minister, has a fixed tenure and enjoys the rank of Secretary to the Government of India.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the appointment, tenure and rank provisions before selecting the combination.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the composition of NITI Aayog:
1. The number of full-time members is not fixed.
2. Part-time members may be drawn from universities and research institutions.
3. Part-time members are ex-officio and rotational.
4. The maximum number of part-time members is two.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. NITI Aayog has no fixed ceiling for full-time members, while it can have at most two rotational, ex-officio part-time members from universities and research bodies.
accepted.tq: Combine the general composition rule with the numerical ceiling for part-time members.
accepted.sec: Composition - full-time, part-time, ex-officio, special invitees  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The maximum number of ex-officio members in NITI Aayog is:
o: Four Union Ministers nominated by the Prime Minister
Two Union Ministers nominated by the Prime Minister
Five Union Ministers nominated by the Governing Council
Three Union Ministers nominated by the President
accepted.x: NITI Aayog may have a maximum of four ex-officio members, who are Union Ministers nominated by the Prime Minister.
accepted.tq: Split the option into number and nominating authority before choosing the correct composition rule.
accepted.sec: Composition - full-time, part-time, ex-officio, special invitees  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Special invitees to NITI Aayog are best described as:
o: Domain experts and practitioners nominated by the Prime Minister
Chief Ministers elected by the Governing Council
Members of Parliament selected by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha
Officials of the Finance Commission nominated by the President
accepted.x: Special invitees are domain experts and practitioners nominated by the Prime Minister.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct category and nominating authority instead of confusing special invitees with ex-officio members.
accepted.sec: Composition - full-time, part-time, ex-officio, special invitees  [APPSC]

accepted.x: V.K. Saraswat, Ramesh Chand and Arvind Virmani were among the outgoing full-time members. Abhay Karandikar belongs to the reconstituted panel.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Vice-Chairpersons of NITI Aayog in chronological order of assumption of office:
A. Suman K. Bery
B. Arvind Panagariya
C. Ashok Kumar Lahiri
D. Rajiv Kumar
accepted.x: The sequence is Arvind Panagariya, Rajiv Kumar, Suman K. Bery and Ashok Kumar Lahiri. Their respective periods began in 2015, 2017, May 2022 and April 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the first and last office-holders, then place the intervening incumbents by year.
